Plot a sample correlation heatmap with annotations

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
plot_heatmap_cor.Rd

Plot a sample correlation heatmap with annotations

Usage

plot_heatmap_cor(
  matrix,
  annotation,
  factor_keys,
  sample_name,
  R2 = FALSE,
  color = c("white", "red"),
  max_sample_label_chars = 20,
  method = "pearson",
  ...
)

Arguments

matrix

numeric matrix - wide-format intensity data

annotation

data.frame - sample annotation

factor_keys

character vector - factor column names for annotation

sample_name

character - sample name column

R2

logical - plot R-squared instead of correlation

color

colours, spread evenly from the lowest to the highest correlation (default white to red)

max_sample_label_chars

maximum displayed sample label length. Labels keep their suffix because sample prefixes are often shared.

method

correlation method: "pearson" (default), "spearman" or "kendall" for stats::cor() on pairwise complete observations, or a function of the matrix returning a sample-by-sample correlation matrix

...

passed to ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap()

Value

invisibly, a ComplexHeatmap Heatmap object of the clustered sample correlations (or R^2 values)

Note

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use LFQData$get_Plotter()$heatmap_cor(). See prolfqua-deprecated.
